scope: Theorem 36.1 of the manuscript “Spacetime Penrose inequalities: enclosing area, charge, and rigidity” (preprints/Spacetime-Penrose-inequalities-enclosing-area-charge-and-rigidity-October-5-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 260 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 794bf524061c4b36), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 228. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For every background, fixed TT seed, and solution branch satisfying (36.1)–(36.6) and the mass assumptions above, there is 0 < ϵ0 ≤ ϵ∗ such that mAH(ϵ) ≥ s Aϵ 16π  1 + Aϵ 4π  (0 ≤ ϵ < ϵ0). For all sufficiently small positive ϵ, equality holds if the seed is radial, and the inequality is strict otherwise.
